job: DevOps Engineer | Platform Engineer | Full stack Developer | Lead tech
bio: DevOps Engineer and Lead Developer with 4 years of experience in full-stack development, automation, CI/CD, and infrastructure management. Specialized in Kubernetes, Docker, and AWS Cloud, I work across the entire project lifecycle—from development to system administration, including DevOps practices and team management within agile methodologies. Passionate about technical challenges, I enjoy proposing innovative solutions to optimize infrastructures and improve application scalability. My holistic approach combines technical expertise with managerial skills to ensure high-performing and efficient projects.

expertise.devops.description: Once the application is built, I help clients set up DevOps testing, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation to ensure a successful Go-Live. I am a Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), so I can deploy applications on a Kubernetes cluster and manage it.

experience.apitech.dev.description: I contributed to the design and industrialization of cloud infrastructures using Kubernetes and Terraform, while managing application containerization and deployments with Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm. I set up and optimized CI/CD pipelines with GitLab CI, automated deployments, and managed multiple environments (development, staging, production). I also configured production servers using Ansible and designed REST APIs to orchestrate and automate infrastructure resources. In parallel, I ensured platform reliability through monitoring and continuous improvements, participated in architectural decisions focused on scalability and resilience, and was actively involved in problem-solving. Additionally, I reviewed pull requests and ensured high code quality standards.

experience.credit.description: Within Crédit Agricole Group Infrastructure Platform, I work as a DevOps Engineer Consultant as part of the MOSART program (Legacy Red Hat Server Modernization), aimed at migrating Linux servers from Red Hat 7 to Red Hat 9 on the group’s internal cloud. The project involves organizing migrations based on application criticality, dependencies, and team capacity, while industrializing and automating processes using Ansible and GitLab CI, with rigorous asset tracking and up-to-date documentation. I collaborate closely with infrastructure, security, and application teams to ensure efficient execution and coordination. I also contribute to migrating databases and legacy solutions to Kubernetes-based environments, as well as server validation and decommissioning. This initiative helps reduce risks related to obsolescence (end of RHEL 7 support since June 2024) while improving system security and stability.
